template.title: Mia's Missing Button Adventure
template.summary: A gentle story about Mia, her stuffed animal, and a friendly friend learning to help each other.

sentences.text_with_blanks: Mia, a bright little girl, loved to play with her favorite stuffed [[slot_pet]] in the sunny park.
One day, her [[slot_toy]] had a missing button, and Mia felt a little sad.
She looked around and saw her friend [[slot_friend]] waving from the swing set.
Mia thought she could just keep playing, but then she remembered how [[slot_friend]] always helped her.
She walked over and said, 'Can you help me find the button?'
Together they searched under the big [[slot_tree]] and near the sparkling [[slot_water_feature]].
Suddenly, they heard a tiny [[slot_sound]] that sounded like a giggling bell.
They followed the sound and found the button stuck in a patch of bright [[slot_color]] moss.
Mia gently pulled it out, and the toy clicked back into place.
She smiled and gave the [[slot_pet]] a big hug, feeling warm like a sunrise.
Then she invited [[slot_friend]] to share a [[slot_snack_food]] under the shade.
They laughed as the [[slot_snack_food]] fell like tiny rain drops on the grass.
Mia realized that sharing made the day brighter, just like the bright sunlight.
They promised to always help each other, no matter how small the problem.
When the sun set, they waved goodbye, feeling happy and safe.
And they went home, dreaming of new adventures with their friends and toys.
